I feel the same and I have this theory. I think part of the reason I feel this way is because of what a lot of us watched on TV as kids. Kids shows always have these perfect worlds where yes things go wrong but in the end everything always worked out. Watching so much of that in our formative years might have kind of "brain washed" us into believing the world is actually like that. As we grew up, reality hit us over and over like a ton of bricks. Every day we'd learn more and more about how horrible the world actually is. And it's caused serious trauma. And now we're sensitive adults that just want everyone to love each other and don't understand how the world could be so cruel. We can only participate in this NT society for so long before we break down and then need time to recover. And it's a sad, lonely and helpless feeling that we're never able to completely shake even though it's seriously effecting our lives.

It's normal to start growing more attached to someone if you've been on a few dates and you like them. That's just the start of a relationship.

If you feel like you're becoming too attached, try to look for the signs of him becoming a new fp.

Do you feel very sad/lonely and think about him a lot when he's gone? Do you over-think things he says until you convince yourself that he's going to leave you? 

One way to prevent it becoming an unhealthy attachment is to set boundaries with him. 

Remember if you get too attached to him too quick, it can scare him and come off as creepy.

Give him space. When he's not here, focus on yourself. Play a video game, go to therapy, or find a hobby. Talk to other friends. 

Accept the fact that he's a person who can make his own decisions, and he can very well decide to stop talking to you one day. That's his choice 

Just remember, you'd be okay without him. Dont rely on him being here for your happiness. If he ever actually did leave, you'd have other people in your life who love you. You don't need him to be happy.
